scheme_name: Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce
other_conditions: Applicant must possess a valid Udyam Registration Certificate at the time of application
Expenses on digitization (software/equipment) must have been incurred after the notification of Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024
The enterprise must have registered on an eCommerce platform after the notification of Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024
Benefits are available only once for each component (digitization equipment and eCommerce platform) per MSME
Only one eCommerce platform fee can be claimed per MSME
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹50,000 (75% of cost) reimbursement for digitization equipment and eCommerce platform fees to eligible Rajasthan MSMEs.
